description: A peer recorded Ed3 by CAS-1 gets EMPTY, never CAPABILITY or another Ed4 EOW.
note: At 2000, from 0.0.1.3, a type 8 D_PDU (EOW 0) carrying a PHYSICAL LINK REQUEST with Ed4 clear (C_PDU 0x10), so the peer is recorded Ed3 (B-0227, B-0408). At 52000 the PHYSICAL LINK ACCEPTED (Ed4 0, Short 0, LINK 0; C_PDU 0x20) goes in a type 8 D_PDU with EOW 0, EMPTY (C-0398), since Ed4 EOWs are not used with Ed3 peers (C-0419, C-0938, C-1260) and no Ed3 recommendation exists before P7-6. The link uses the 8-bit family (B-0232), which changes no output here. Fixture: preamble 600, flush 150, 25 bytes and 4800 ms a block; the type 8 D_PDU carrying a one-byte CAS-1 C_PDU (address size 3, C-0133) is 25 bytes, so the transmission is one block, 5550 ms, and every D_PDU in it starts in block 0: EOT ceil(4950 / 500) = 10 (C-0104, C-1043), and the type 8 reception window 10 (C-0350). Burst end 3000: csma.vdcd_end 4000; at 7000 LBT rule 1 (K-0067, K-0068), seed 0 draws slot 15, CONT_WAIT 45000 (K-0080). The link is made when the accept has been sent, at 57550 (B-0213, B-0400, C-1100), with the timers of cas-make-called-accept.
